requirements.text: The system should allow customers to select services, choose a barber, and view available appointment times.
Customers should be able to easily change or cancel their appointments without needing to call the barbershop.
Each barber should be able to manage their own schedule, including setting availability, taking breaks, and marking days off.
The system must be simple and budget-friendly, avoiding unnecessary complexity.
Automated reminders should be sent to customers via text and email, one day and one hour before their appointments.
